entities.summary: The development and deployment of technologies that reduce environmental impact — solar, wind, electric vehicles, green building, carbon capture. Driven by climate science, policy incentives, and falling costs, green technology has grown from a niche concern to a multi-trillion-dollar industry transforming energy, transportation, and construction.
